CustomObject.description: Deactivate the configured profile user after set number of days. Create one record per profile. The Label must be the exact profile name (the batch matches on it). The Record Name should be the profile name too, with spaces and special characters replaced by underscores (Salesforce fills this in from the Label). Record names are not guaranteed to be unique across profiles, so avoid profiles whose names differ only by spaces or punctuation.
CustomObject.label: Auto User Inactive
